data.narrative:
Black Forest Labs is a Series B AI & Software company founded by Robin Rombach, Andreas Blattmann, and Patrick Esser, with $300M raised to date. The valuation analysis draws on a comparable universe of seven same-sector and adjacent-stage private companies, supplemented by one public comparable (Palantir, ticker PLTR).

Stage-progression methodology was not applicable; the current stated valuation of $3.25B implies a step-up to $6.2B, which exceeds 20x total capital raised and is inconsistent with funding-tracker data. The peer-median approach yielded a valuation of $10.0B across the seven-company cohort, which includes Figure AI ($39.0B, Series C), Reflection AI ($25.0B, Series A), Skild AI ($14.0B, Series C), Crusoe Energy ($10.0B, Series C), and Together AI ($8.3B, Series C). The peer range spans $2.0B to $39.0B.

The triangulated valuation range is $8.5B to $11.5B, with a median of $10.0B. This range reflects the concentration of comparables in the $8B–$14B band and accommodates stage and maturity differences within the cohort. Key uncertainties include product-market fit validation, unit economics durability, and the heterogeneity of valuation outcomes across the AI frontier-tech space, where stage-agnostic valuations (e.g., Reflection AI at Series A) complicate traditional progression benchmarks.
